unresolved.detail: Official patch wording refers to basic Attack Damage percentage ending at 2%; raw rows are PercentADBonusDamage=0.04 and PercentHealthBonusDamage=0.02. Do not change one based on matching the new number alone; verify live asset.
Official patch calls stats AD/AP, but archived statLine and curves expose AD/AS. AD is 0.25 and AS multiplier is 1.25; AP field missing. Verify source semantics, not just new numeric values.
Official article repeats Reduction Per Cast with different old values (4 and 10), but both end at 5. Treat as one current target, not two sequential changes.

Raw snapshot retains DeathsDefiance and Hullcrusher records although official patch removes them from artifact availability. Presence of a definition is not proof of live availability; require set/loot inclusion metadata before deleting definitions.
No separate B/C/D titled documents found; official article uses dates. Preserve date/section context when archiving, since current patchnotes.json flattens it away.

Amumu 3/4-star heal coefficient is 0.04 in archived data; official note gives only 2.2 to 2.5, so preserve 0.04 until live source establishes otherwise. Current simulator only supports 1/2-star Amumu.

The published correction explicitly names Riftbeast (7), column 3. The archived 10-unit tooltip adds only 2 maximum team size, so its growth is inferred to inherit the corrected 7-unit bonus. Column 4 therefore also receives 5% AD/AP/AS, preserving the earlier modeled behavior. The raw styles are [1, 3, 4, 4], and the simulator high context includes the 10-unit column 4. Direct live confirmation of column 4 is unavailable; this inheritance remains an inference and is not included among the verified numeric patch targets.

The numeric targets do not verify engine mechanics from bug-fix notes: August 27 Soul Awakening ability damage and Gnar/Krug combat termination; September 1 Adaptor starred scaling, Adaptor form mana, and Alune untargetable-target exclusion. Most concern augments, board state, or actions outside the current fixed-dummy simulator.
